asset.name: ResourceCollectionFixture
asset.description: Adversarial mock records for any surface that presents a collection of named, owned, timestamped, status-bearing resources — the shape most operational collection surfaces actually render.

rationale: The first fixture, and the one that proves the kind is worth having: it lets collection-page, data-table, and search-filter-results each be captured in every declared state with no scenario adopting them. Its overflow shape is deliberately hostile — 200-character resource names, absent optional owners, an Arabic name among Latin ones, and timestamps far enough apart to break naive relative formatting — because a fixture that only supplies well-formed records reproduces exactly the false confidence it exists to prevent.
